title: 真实Grafana文件权威修复：API保存被覆盖，落盘后两次重载保持
answer:
```python
import json,pathlib
def persist(path,uid,title,request):
    target=pathlib.Path(path)
    if target.is_symlink() or not target.is_file() or not isinstance(title,str) or not title.strip():raise ValueError('real authoritative file and title required')
    document=json.loads(target.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    if document.get('uid')!=uid:raise ValueError('approved stable dashboard UID required')
    document['title']=title
    target.write_text(json.dumps(document,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
```

原题知识说明：
确认UID对应文件与allowUiUpdates行为，旧文件仍是权威来源。将批准变更保存到受管理仪表盘数据文件并按流程发布，避免反复UI覆盖。验证重载与重启后保持，并保留旧版恢复点。

conversion.original_title: UI修改仪表盘后稍后自动变回旧版，日志显示文件provisioning刷新。如何处理？

body:
## 操作任务
实现persist(path,uid,title,request)，修复独立训练实例中由文件provisioning覆盖页面保存的故障。只修改给定权威JSON文件的title，必须保留uid及所有其他字段、文件0640权限；初始文件必须真实非symlink且uid匹配、title为非空字符串，非法情况ValueError且不改文件。request仅允许查看目标或模拟界面API保存；只改数据库不能完成修复。夹具先证明API保存标题成功、随后文件版本刷新使其回到旧标题，再验证修正文件后连续两次真实provisioning重载仍保持批准标题。保留实例默认用户身份、其他仪表盘、provider、原面板及文件夹。不得禁用provisioning或更换UID绕过覆盖。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Grafana11.6.0、私有SQLite及文件provider；通过与界面保存对应的HTTP API复现数据库修改，显式admin reload触发受控文件刷新，不声称已逐次点击Grafana界面或等待生产定时器。无生产连接、默认宿主身份或权限变更；只读既有分发及2GiB非root隔离预算，不构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,json,os,pathlib,secrets,sqlite3,sys,time
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
from grafana_native import PrivateGrafana
uid='owned-'+secrets.token_hex(5);other_uid='kept-'+secrets.token_hex(5);title='Approved '+secrets.token_hex(8)
def document(ident,name):return dict(uid=ident,title=name,schemaVersion=39,version=1,tags=['release-0'],timezone='utc',panels=[dict(id=1,type='text',title='Keep panel',gridPos=dict(x=0,y=0,w=12,h=4),options=dict(mode='markdown',content='unchanged'))])
def prepare(server):
 server.target=server.root/'dashboards/owned.json';server.other=server.root/'dashboards/protected.json'
 server.target.write_text(json.dumps(document(uid,'Old file title')),encoding='utf8');server.target.chmod(0o640)
 server.other.write_text(json.dumps(document(other_uid,'Protected dashboard')),encoding='utf8');server.other.chmod(0o640)
 provider=dict(apiVersion=1,providers=[dict(name='Owned file provider',orgId=1,folder='Owned training',folderUid='owned-folder',type='file',disableDeletion=False,allowUiUpdates=True,updateIntervalSeconds=3600,options=dict(path=str(server.root/'dashboards')))])
 server.provider=server.root/'provisioning/dashboards/owned.yaml';server.provider.write_text(json.dumps(provider),encoding='utf8')
def call(server,method,path,body=None):
 status,value=server.request(method,path,body);assert status==200,(method,path,status,value);return value
with PrivateGrafana(prepare) as server:
 def get(ident):return call(server,'GET','/api/dashboards/uid/'+ident)
 def wait_title(ident,wanted):
  deadline=time.monotonic()+5
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   value=get(ident)
   if value['dashboard']['title']==wanted:return value
   time.sleep(.05)
  raise AssertionError('actual dashboard title did not converge: '+str(value['dashboard']['title']))
 def source_revision(revision):
  value=json.loads(server.target.read_text());value['tags']=['release-'+str(revision)];server.target.write_text(json.dumps(value),encoding='utf8')
 def reload():call(server,'POST','/api/admin/provisioning/dashboards/reload')
 def ownership(dashboard_id):
  connection=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(server.root/'grafana.db')+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
  try:return connection.execute('select name,external_id from dashboard_provisioning where dashboard_id=?',(dashboard_id,)).fetchall()
  finally:connection.close()
 deadline=time.monotonic()+10
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  status,old=server.request('GET','/api/dashboards/uid/'+uid)
  if status==200 and old['meta'].get('provisionedExternalId')=='owned.json' and old['dashboard']['title']=='Old file title':break
  time.sleep(.05)
 else:raise AssertionError('initial file provisioning not ready: '+repr((status,old)))
 assert old['meta']['provisioned'] is False and ownership(old['dashboard']['id'])==[('Owned file provider',str(server.target))],'allowUiUpdates does not remove actual file-provider ownership'
 protected=get(other_uid);other_file=server.other.read_bytes();provider_file=server.provider.read_bytes();user=call(server,'GET','/api/user');identity={k:user[k] for k in ('id','login','orgId','isGrafanaAdmin')}
 changed=copy.deepcopy(old['dashboard']);changed['title']=title
 call(server,'POST','/api/dashboards/db',dict(dashboard=changed,folderUid=old['meta']['folderUid'],overwrite=True))
 wait_title(uid,title)
 source_revision(1);reload();old_again=wait_title(uid,'Old file title')
 assert old_again['dashboard']['id']==old['dashboard']['id'] and ownership(old_again['dashboard']['id'])==[('Owned file provider',str(server.target))]
 print('NATIVE_GRAFANA_DB_EDIT_ACCEPTED_THEN_ACTUAL_FILE_PROVISIONING_OVERWRITES_OLD_TITLE',flush=True)
 original_source=json.loads(server.target.read_text());expected_source={**original_source,'title':title}
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:persist_approved_dashboard_title_in_authoritative_file_keep_uid',flush=True)
 def request(method,path,body=None):
  assert (method,path) in [('GET','/api/dashboards/uid/'+uid),('POST','/api/dashboards/db')],'unapproved API operation'
  if method=='POST':assert body['dashboard']['uid']==uid
  return server.request(method,path,body)
 try:task.persist(server.target,uid,title,request)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('authoritative dashboard repair failed') from error
 after_source=json.loads(server.target.read_text())
 source_revision(2);reload();current=wait_title(uid,title)
 assert after_source==expected_source,'only title may change in the authoritative source; stable UID required'
 source_revision(3);reload();current=wait_title(uid,title)
 assert current['dashboard']['id']==old['dashboard']['id'] and current['dashboard']['uid']==uid
 assert current['dashboard']['panels']==old['dashboard']['panels'] and current['meta']['folderUid']==old['meta']['folderUid'] and ownership(current['dashboard']['id'])==[('Owned file provider',str(server.target))]
 kept=get(other_uid);assert {k:kept['dashboard'][k] for k in ('id','uid','title','panels')}=={k:protected['dashboard'][k] for k in ('id','uid','title','panels')}
 assert server.other.read_bytes()==other_file and server.provider.read_bytes()==provider_file and server.target.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o640
 user=call(server,'GET','/api/user');assert {k:user[k] for k in identity}==identity,'fixture default identity or administrator status changed'
 saved=server.target.read_bytes()
 try:task.persist(server.target,'wrong-uid',title,request)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('unapproved source UID accepted')
 assert server.target.read_bytes()==saved
 link=server.root/'linked.json';link.symlink_to(server.target)
 try:task.persist(link,uid,title,request)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('symlink source accepted')
 assert server.target.read_bytes()==saved
 print('NATIVE_GRAFANA_AUTHORITY_FILE_REPAIR_SURVIVES_TWO_REPROVISIONINGS_UID_PANELS_OTHER_DASHBOARD_IDENTITY_KEPT',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
